name: Rasen Rankeisen Cxielarko
original_name: 螺旋卵形線チェルアルコ
source:
When I woke up, I was in another world.
A fantasy so cliché it was almost laughable—wizards, sorcerers, the works.
But the one summoned here? Just a regular high school girl.
“Yeah, yeah, I know this story. I’ve read it in manga before.”

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/22040]freem[/url]]
